draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.38, the 30th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 4th of 37 at CB. He went 22nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Sean Smith. Testing standouts: broad jump (80th percentile). College production: his final season (2019) ranked 2nd in passes defended among the 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 21 career games and 3 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2022. Weak spots: passes defended 0 (8th percentile), approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Played 9 of 17 games in 2024.
